css: .section.is-dark { background-color: #141613; color: #b9b6ad; } .on-dark { color: #f2ede4; } .eyebrow.on-dark { color: #f2ede4; } .lead.on-dark { color: #c9c5bb; } .text-link.on-dark { color: #f2ede4; } .omakase-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-column-gap: 96px; align-items: center; } .omakase-image-wrap { border-radius: 28px 28px 999px 999px; overflow: hidden; height: 680px; } .step-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-top: 1px solid rgba(242, 237, 228, 0.16); } .step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr; grid-column-gap: 16px; padding-top: 28px; padding-bottom: 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(242, 237, 228, 0.16); } .step-number { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; color: #f08a5d; } .step-title { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.15; color: #f2ede4; margin-bottom: 6px; } .price-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; grid-column-gap: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(242, 237, 228, 0.3); border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 22px; color: #f2ede4; } .price-pill-value { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; } @media screen and (max-width: 991px) { .omakase-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-row-gap: 56px; } .omakase-image-wrap { height: 520px; } }
